title: Admin ops utility journey mapping and task transformation
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Convert high-friction admin flows into composable, observable task objects that can be executed by the support automation runner. Scope: map 6 common operator journeys (node reprovision, model rollback, quota reset, emergency scale-up, db credentials rotation, archive customer logs) into task templates + idempotent step primitives. Acceptance criteria: (1) each journey has a task template, a JSON schema for inputs, and a safety checklist; (2) tasks are executable via opsctl and the operator web UI; (3) replayable in sandbox with deterministic dry-run output; (4) traces emitted to tracing pipeline and cost/latency metrics instrumented. Background: recent incident INC-2026-02-14 exposed three manual steps that blocked on ad-hoc scripts; this ticket aims to reduce mean time to remediation by standardizing these flows and enabling runbooks-as-tasks.
